scripts.release:rollback:
pnpm exec wrangler versions list && printf '
Manual rollback ONLY - this script changes nothing.
1. Pick the last known-good version ID above.
2. Run: pnpm exec wrangler rollback <version-id> -m "<reason>"
3. Re-run: pnpm release:smoke
Note: rollback restores code, not secret values (see spec.md 12.1).
'
